column1: # The probe plan of 2026-10-27 for rows P16b, T24b and T24f of SJL-13.1's correspondence, in plan.tsv's columns: one
# line per probe and engine, written from the code at the correspondence's heads before the run (run_p16b.sh beside
# this file). plan.tsv, the plan of 2026-10-26, is unchanged. Expected answers are the code's; the run compares.
# Commands use run_p16b.sh's variables, which are run_all.sh's: $PROBES = <corr>/probes, $RUNS = <corr>/runs,
# $WORK = <corr>/runner-work; $VM_SC and $VM_CF = the Release DLLs of Broiler.VM's SliceCompiler and Conformance roots
# in $VMW (4cf9ca4); $JS_PC = the SJL-12 parse-corpus tool's and $JS_SH = the shell BroilerJS's Release DLLs in $JSW
# (d6795fc8). Every command runs under TZ=UTC with LANG, LANGUAGE, LC_* and BROILER_* unset. A parse probe's answer is
# that id's rows of its manifest's one run; a value line's answer is the line its label begins (P's lines are named
# PE<nn>, T's TV-<label>, so that no answer file name differs from a parse probe's only in case). "S" is THROWS
# SyntaxError: <message>; messages are not predicted. Line numbers cited are VMC/JsParser.cs's and Broiler.JS
